name: Longyan
registryAssessment: Longyan Municipal Natural Resources Bureau first-party material identifies a Natural Resources Survey and Registration division (also the real-estate registration bureau), responsible for natural-resource and real-estate unified registration, cadastral surveying, and a municipal registration information platform. This establishes local registry custody, not an open parcel-vector feed.

queries.query: Longyan China official cadastral map parcel GIS land registration natural resources
queries.result: First-party Longyan Natural Resources Bureau results identified the municipal Natural Resources Survey and Registration division, cadastral-survey responsibilities, unified registration platform, and a public multi-survey information platform. No anonymous public cadastral parcel ID+geometry endpoint was verified.

officialSources.role: Longyan Municipal Natural Resources Bureau organization page
officialSources.observation: The Natural Resources Survey and Registration division is responsible for unified natural-resource and real-estate registration, cadastral survey, registration-information management, and supervision of cadastral surveying; the bureau also manages a natural-resources one-map system.

officialSources.role: Longyan Municipal Natural Resources Bureau multi-survey reform notice
officialSources.observation: Describes the existing Longyan multi-survey information platform, integration with approval and real-estate registration systems, cadastral-data sharing, and submission of survey results to the bureau. This is service/custody evidence, not an open parcel download.

Anonymous frontend is reachable and its public configuration identifies baseUrl https://www.lytdt.com:9002/longyan-dchy-web, basemap WKID 3857, and area-data WKID 4548. The exposed public map routes are land-project publicity routes; no anonymous cadastral parcel layer response was obtained.

officialSources.role: Longyan government real-estate registration press material
officialSources.observation: First-party government material describes the municipal real-estate registration center and online registration services, but does not publish a safe open parcel-vector service.

geometryDecision.reason: No safe native parcel ID plus full polygon was returned by anonymous public requests. The public multi-survey frontend exposed CRS/configuration and land-project publicity routes, not a verified cadastral parcel layer. The WUP point [25.0997041427901, 117.024047113305] was preserved exactly and was not shifted; no exact-point hit or miss is asserted.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Longyan municipal natural-resource and real-estate registration/cadastral-survey custody under the Municipal Natural Resources Bureau, with a multi-survey platform.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Local registry custody, platform existence, public frontend configuration, and CRS metadata only; parcel layer schema, native parcel identity, anonymous geometry, exact-point containment, and citywide open coverage remain unverified.
